privacy.showActivityHint: Sessions count and streak on your profile. Off by default.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.reduceMotionHint: Turns off screen and tab animations.

nutrition.title: The trainer's day on a plate
nutrition.lead: What the trainer actually eats on a given day. Save it and use it as an example.
nutrition.disclaimer: This is one person's day, not a plan for everyone. Needs differ with age, activity, health and goals. Treat it as inspiration, not a prescription; for diets and medical conditions consult a specialist.
nutrition.emptyBody: The trainer's daily plates will appear here.

health.title: My health
health.lead: Your numbers, visible only to you.
health.signedOutTitle: Sign in to use this section
health.signedOutBody: Measurements and health details are stored in your account and never shown to other people.
health.disclaimer: These figures are for your own orientation. The app does not make medical conclusions and does not promise results. For health concerns consult a specialist.
health.profileLead: Optional. Used for the estimate and for tailoring recommendations later.
health.measurementsLead: One entry per day; the same date overwrites the previous value.

health.notEnough: Add at least {count} entries in this period to see a chart.
health.appleHealthBody: Steps, heart rate and sleep can only be read by the native iOS app with your per-type permission. The web version cannot access them, so there is no connect button here.
health.appleHealthStatus: Status: not available in this version · planned for the iOS app
